name: Yoshida Sayuri
source: With their only useful clue a flyer announcing the opening of a new mahjong club in the city, the protagonist, Miyabi and Yumika pay a visit to the club's gaming hall. There they find the hall is only open in the evenings, but a part-time employee named Sayuri is working there. She recognizes the leaflet, but can not say anymore on the subject, or inform the party where the owner of the gaming hall is at the moment. The party coax this information out of her through a game of strip mahjong.
